acceptedNote: Accepted — outcome unknown yet. Check the run history under Scheduled tasks.

changes.confirmBody: This restores #{{pk}} in {{table}} to its value before the change. The rollback is itself a write and leaves a new audit entry.
changes.desc: Exactly which fields this operation changed. Revertible ones get a rollback button.
changes.empty: This entry has no field-level detail (usually a read or an external call).
changes.forceHint: Overwrite even if someone else changed this record after this change. ⚠️ Ticking this means their later edit is wiped out by the rollback — without it the system refuses, which is a safeguard, not a failure.
changes.reverted: Rolled back, and a new audit entry was recorded
changes.title: Field-level changes

detail.acceptedBody: The request was accepted; the actual work runs in the background — "accepted" does not mean it succeeded. Check the run history under Scheduled tasks for the real outcome.
detail.countMismatch: ⚠️ The record claims {{count}} changes but none could be loaded. That is an inconsistency, not "no changes".
detail.maskedChanged: Changed (sensitive field — the audit records that it changed, never the value)
detail.noDiff: ⚠️ The change record exists but no field values were captured — the snapshot failed; it does not mean nothing changed.
detail.noSnapshot: This kind of operation does not modify a single row, so there is no before/after to compare. It acts on an external system (registrar, DNS, CA) or is a trigger action; see the endpoint result above and the run history.
detail.title: Operation detail

empty.none: No write operation has been performed yet.
empty.title: No audit entries

error.title: Could not load the audit log

objectHistory.desc: Who changed which fields on this object, and when. Only audited write operations are recorded — field changes written back by collection jobs are not.
objectHistory.noDiff: The operation was recorded, but no field-level diff was captured
objectHistory.none: No changes recorded for this object
objectHistory.noneHint: This does not mean nobody ever changed it: only audited write operations appear here, not values written back by collection jobs.
objectHistory.title: Change history for {{name}}

title: Audit log
writeOnlyNote: Scope: every write operation, plus every AI call via MCP — including read-only queries, because what the AI took must be traceable. Humans browsing read-only pages is not recorded, so not finding "which page someone viewed" is expected.
